precision: bfloat16 base; unmerged adapter as in validated loader
normalization: NFKC, lowercase, remove ASCII punctuation and Unicode category P, remove English articles a/an/the, collapse whitespace; empty normalized answer never correct
panel_order: eligible questions by ascending SHA256(str(id)), keep first per subject; subjects by descending s_pop and ascending raw string subj_id; deduplicate normalized questions in this order then first 100
alias_eligibility: at least one nonempty-normalized alias with <=8 tokens without special tokens in BOTH released adapter tokenizers

uncertainty.method: paired whole-question percentile bootstrap with Bonferroni correction across the three primary contrasts

decision_rule: pain-specific short-answer accuracy reduction on this panel only if the upper bound of each simultaneous interval for pain-minus-none, pain-minus-random, pain-minus-sadness is <0
